title: Specify a beam-bending rig for a second-year strength of materials lab
person: A lecturer writing the requirements for six teaching rigs that the workshop and an outside supplier will quote against.
review: Simply supported span adjustable 300 mm to 800 mm, 20 mm × 6 mm beams in steel, aluminium and brass, loads up to 500 N in 5 N steps, a dial gauge reading 0.01 mm over 0 mm to 25 mm, set-up within 10 min, footprint at most 1.5 m × 0.75 m, frame deflection below 1 % of beam deflection at full load, at most 40 kg; the load-cell option is a TBD for Dr Amara Osei by 4 December 2026, and the six rigs and the delivery date stay out of the product requirements.
revised_review: The maximum load is 300 N and the gauge travel 0 mm to 30 mm everywhere; nothing else changed.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Every requirement has an id of its own, used once.
Requirements say shall, facts will and goals should; nothing says must.
No vague word from the notes survives into a requirement.
Every TBD or TBR has an owner and a date.
Every requirement names test, analysis, inspection or demonstration.
Every value has a space before its unit symbol, °C and % included.
The notes' unit spellings are replaced by the SI symbols.
The load-cell option is a TBD owned by Dr Amara Osei and due by 4 December 2026.
The quantity of six rigs and the delivery before the spring term are kept apart from the product requirements.
"Safe for students" and "easy to set up" are turned into conditions someone can check.
The maximum load is 300 N and the gauge travel 0 mm to 30 mm everywhere; nothing else changed.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the companies, schools and people are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
